rows.text: 交流电压时灯泡就亮了。
如果电路实际上是断路（在电容器极板之间电荷不可能
通过），交流电流怎么能够在电路中通过呢？这里实际上是在
交流电压作用下，电容器周期性地充电和放电。电容器反复
充电时，电路里的电流使电灯灯丝变热了。
如果导线和电容器极板的电阻可以忽略不计，我们来求
出只有电容器的电路中电流强度是如何随时间变化的
等于电路两端的电压（其中q为上极板的电量）。因此，
电容器的电量按简谐规律变化：
作为电量对时间的导数的电流强度等于：

objects: Four external terminal marks: left upper +, left lower -, and two right terminals with a ~ sign between them.
Four small hollow central upper contacts arranged across the switching area, plus two hollow lower contacts.
Stepped wires from the two left and two right supply terminals to the central contacts.
A dark horizontal central switch/bridge stroke with short upright strokes at its ends; exact stroke-to-contact segmentation requires an existing crop.
Lower rectangular wire loop from the left lower contact around left and bottom to a two-plate capacitor at right.
Circle containing a diagonal X (lamp) in the upper-right segment of that lower loop.
Two thick horizontal capacitor plates at the right side of the loop, separated by a visible white gap.
relationships: Lamp lies on the upper wire between the lower-right switching contact and the right-side capacitor.
The capacitor is on the loop's right vertical segment; its lower plate continues to the bottom return wire.
The + and - labels apply to the left supply terminal pair; ~ lies between the right supply terminals.
No inferred closed/open switching state or unprinted component value is asserted.
